updates.note: Management reported yearly value growth at 4.3% on standalone (and similar context), practically near mid-single digit, and discussed FY26 actuals.
Q4 FY26 volume growth achieved was 12.4% for decorative business (exceeding the 8-10% target band).
Management explicitly stated they are maintaining their margin guidance of 18-20%.
updates.quote: We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.

new_promises.statement: We target high single-digit volume growth for FY27.
new_promises.quote: we are still looking atleast a high single-digit volume growth in terms of what we would kind of achieve
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

new_promises.statement: We expect to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE project in H1 FY27.
new_promises.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
